note: Charts as a seed-declared manifest (item 2 refactor). `name` is the chart id; `tag` is the [a-z]+ control-character tag nu wraps every address in, hashed into SEED.lock; `behavior` selects the normalizer/classifier/segmenter, keyed by id in engine code. Adding a chart is a manifest row plus (if the behavior is new) three registered functions — no dispatch edit.
